reviews.author: INcLine Museum_IncLine
reviews.text:
Sinchon Eagle Cafe is a 50-year-old cafe located on the 8th floor of Eagle Building, 36 Yonsei-ro, Seodaemun-gu, Seoul. It is a 5-minute walk from Exit 3 of Sinchon Station. It first opened as a music cafe, and for a long time it was loved as a hangout for college students, writers, and debaters. Now, it has been reborn as a sophisticated space with a retro and vintage feel, and the space can be divided and used according to purposes such as ‘solitary’ (studying alone), ‘subang’ (relaxation), and ‘libang’ (gathering).

The interior has an old-fashioned feel with dark wood and brown tones, and there is a terrace outside, offering a spectacular night view of Yonsei University, Changcheon Church, and the Seodaemun area. The atmosphere is nice, so it can be used for a variety of purposes, including dating, quietly reading a book, working on a laptop, and gathering.

The menu is full of old names and retro sensibility, such as black coffee (5,800 won), milk coffee (6,500 won), Dabang Coffee (6,800 won), Vienna coffee (7,200 won), and Ssanghwa tea (7,800 won), and simple desserts such as cakes and roll cakes are also available. The price range of drinks is a bit high compared to Sinchon, but black coffee can be refilled for free once with a receipt (ice is 500 won extra). Desserts made with homemade cream are also very popular, and the rich hot chocolate has a rich, deep flavor made by melting the chocolate directly.

The advantages are 1) a quiet and warm atmosphere, 2) the photos taken on the terrace are really pretty, and 3) a unique room configuration optimized for each purpose. On the other hand, please note that 1) public transportation is recommended as parking is not available, 2) there may always be a wait during peak hours, and 3) the prices of drinks and cakes are higher than regular cafes.

Looking at the reviews, there are many positive reviews such as “The view is beautiful,” “Comfortable for both studying and conversation,” “The drinks are expensive, but the view and impressive space make up for it all,” and “The hot chocolate and coffee shop are highly recommended.” If you are looking for Sinchon, Yonsei University, a view, and a retro feel, this is a real attraction worth stopping by!

#Sinchon Cafe #Eagle Cafe #Sinchon View Restaurant #Yonsei University Cafe #Sinchon Rooftop #Retro Cafe #Sinchon Date #Seoul Cafe Recommendation #Old-fashioned Cafe #Good Cafe for Studying

The drinks look really pretty for taking pictures, but when you actually drink them, they taste so good that you can remember them even if you haven't tried them.

reviews.author: Brave H
reviews.text: The best cafe with history. It's a nice and cozy space. This is a place I want to visit often. As long as there are empty seats... it offers a great view. Is it a joke if the name ‘Eagle Coffee Shop’ reminds one of ‘Eagle Fortress’ or ‘Eagle Official’? As I take the elevator to the coffee shop, I think back to the elevator I lined up to ride up to Hitler's Eagle Fortress on the outskirts of Austria. What they have in common is that you can go up by elevator and see a great view, but unlike Eagle Fortress, which is cold, dreary, and gloomy, Eagle Teahouse here is a warm and bright place. Wasn't this the 'clean, well-lighted place' that Hemingway wanted to talk about in his novel? A well-organized, cozy and friendly space. The Ssanghwa tea I tried instead of coffee was also really delicious. (The peanut crumbs that spilled on the saucer were spilled while carrying it.)

reviews.author: Jamung (CanoeNerd)
reviews.text:
I went to Munjakgwi Cafe because it opened.
On Friday, December 1st, the line started at 7:11 am and reservations began around 8:30.
I received reservation number 25 (estimated waiting time was 150 minutes).
The waiting line closed very late on Wednesday and Thursday, but from Friday onwards, a lot of people started coming. On this day, the queue closed at 8:44. Those who want to come on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday should arrive by at least 8 a.m. If you come around 7 a.m. Like me, I think you will be able to make a reservation safely.

The line at the Munjakgwi Cafe is different from the line at the pop-up!! The cafe line is on the basement level, one escalator down, and the pop-up line is from there and you have to take another escalator. There is a separate pop-up line there

Those who want to wait in line must dress very warmly. It was really cold when I stood in line in front of the Uplex door. Even if you're inside the building, the wind blows in from outside the door and it's really cold. Be sure to wear thick socks, otherwise it'll be difficult.

Oh, and you can make reservations for the Munjakgwi Cafe even if you are standing in line alone, but for the pop-up, only those waiting in line can make reservations. Please note

Anyway, I entered a little after 12am. Before entering, there is a machine in front of the cafe that takes out photo cards with long frames. Try it out. It costs 3,000 won per card.

The store is smaller than I thought. There were about 12 tables. It was nice to take pictures because the interior was decorated cutely.

The menu items I ordered were Rabbit Carrot Milk Tea, Ratko Vienna Coffee Set, and Ramen Mont Blanc.

I wasn't expecting rabbit carrot milk tea at all, but it's delicious??? It really seemed like it had a little bit of carrot in it and it had a strange taste. It tastes a bit like mango... Surprisingly delicious menu

The Vienna coffee was pretty, but the cream wasn't that delicious. The cookies that come with it are just okay to eat. Try dipping cookies in coffee!

Ramen Mont Blanc is just... okay, it tastes like cheap chestnut bean paste... but I'm satisfied because it looks cute. Chiikawa’s head was also like chestnut paste.

Also, if you take a picture of your food and post it on Instagram, you will receive a random transparent poker card. We got the Kuri Manju poker card. But the condition of the poker is so bad ㅡㅡ..How on earth did you store it? There are too many scratches. I was a little angry… … Really...yeah...^^; I guess it’s because it’s free..

reviews.text:
On hot summer days, I crave bubble tea, so I often go to Gong Cha stores here and there.  I am satisfied with the Gongcha drink itself, but I am a bit dissatisfied with the service at the Sinchon branch I visited today.

Ordering is done on the 1st floor and seating is on the 2nd floor, but there is no monitor or speaker on the 2nd floor to tell you that your drink is ready, and there is no vibrating bell. To get a drink, you just have to wait on the first floor.

The 3 drinks we ordered came out, so we asked the staff for a tray, and the only reply was, "We don't have any." It would have been nice if they could at least say sorry for not being prepared or something... In the end, I had to go up and down the second floor twice holding the drink cup in my hand.

When I go to a cafe, I don't expect to be treated kindly or receive great service.  It would be nice if they could let us know when the drinks we ordered are ready or provide basic convenience such as a tray or carrier to carry multiple drinks.  (Basic level that is provided in all other cafes)

Today's drink was delicious, but I'm not in a very good mood.

It's a place with a long-established atmosphere where alcohol is inevitable!
Even people who like beer should drink makgeolli here, and people who like soju should definitely drink makgeolli here!
It has an atmosphere that makes one drink become two and two drinks become four.

Those who were unfamiliar become closer,
A place where secrets that were known to oneself are shared with everyone.
This is a place where worries you used to worry about alone become a thing of the past thanks to everyone’s worries and well-wishes!

I look forward to visiting again next time~

reviews.text: This Hoffa chain bar is the perfect place to party! The prices are relatively affordable, the staff are friendly and welcoming, the service is top notch and the atmosphere is warm and comfortable. There are six clean and spacious private rooms that can accommodate up to 10 people, perfect for gatherings with friends or entertaining guests. Top-of-the-line karaoke equipment, a regularly updated song list, and outstanding sound quality allow you to sing your heart out. We also provide delicious food and drinks so you can have a great time. The facilities are well maintained and the environment is clean and hygienic. Whether it's a birthday party or a casual gathering, this is an ideal choice. Highly recommended to friends who enjoy singing and nightlife. Very satisfied with the price!
